policy: Public presentation exclusions only. Master files and factual source metadata remain untouched. Owner rejections are authoritative and permanent for the rejected export version: automated curation must never re-enable them. An owner rejection blocks a specific edited export (filename + sha256), together with its derivatives and any renamed copy of it — not the underlying capture. A future owner re-edit of the same capture is a new version and may be reviewed independently.
